fullPassage: The ambulance has given life to many dying patients with its quick service. Its story goes back to 1792 when Napoleon's personal physician Baron Dominique Jean Larrey had the brilliant idea that wounded soldiers should be taken out of the battlefield on a horse carriage. Before then, there was no provision to carry them out and wounded soldiers were usually left to their fate. Dr. Dominique, together with the chief surgeon of the French army, Dr. Pierre-François Percy, established the Ambulance Corps. Each division had 12 such ambulances. This corps was used in the 1796 war between France and Italy. It was a great success. Many countries followed suit and built their own fleet of ambulances. In 1864, the ambulance was officially accepted in the International Geneva Agreement and it was decided that no one would attack an ambulance during war.

det.korean: leave(원형) → left(과거분사): were + p.p. 수동태, '운명에 내버려졌다'
det.analysis: were + usually + p.p. → left (과거 수동태, 불규칙 변화 leave-left-left)
det.tip: leave(원형) → left(과거분사): 불규칙 변화 + 수동태

overlay.excerptSentences: Before then, there was no provision to carry them out and wounded soldiers were usually __________ (leave) to their fate.

questions.passage: The ambulance has given life to many dying patients with its quick service. Its story goes back to 1792 when Napoleon's personal physician Baron Dominique Jean Larrey had the brilliant idea that wounded soldiers should be taken out of the battlefield __________. Before then, there was no provision to carry them out and wounded soldiers were usually left to their fate. Dr. Dominique, together with the chief surgeon of the French army, Dr. Pierre-François Percy, established the Ambulance Corps. Each division had 12 such ambulances. This corps was used in the 1796 war between France and Italy. It was a great success. Many countries followed suit and built their own fleet of ambulances. In 1864, the ambulance was officially accepted in the International Geneva Agreement and it was decided that no one would attack an ambulance during war.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: on a horse carriage(마차 위에) — 부상당한 병사를 마차 위에 실어 전장에서 옮겨야 한다는 아이디어
det.analysis:
❌ ① in the International Geneva Agreement: 제네바 협약에서, 마지막 문장 맥락이나 전장에서 옮기는 수단이 아님
❌ ② to their fate: 운명으로, 반대 맥락(버려진 상태)
✅ ③ on a horse carriage: 원문 'taken out of the battlefield on a horse carriage'
❌ ④ with its quick service: 빠른 서비스로, 도입부 표현이나 taken out과 결합 부자연
det.tip: taken out of the battlefield __________ → on a horse carriage(마차 위에)
